== Summary ==
Slip “•Mapuzo: Safehouse” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 620, 755, 1169)). Version [[Mapuzo: Safehouse|Mapuzo: Safehouse (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
